00Evidence
Validation Chamber
Presence, freshness, timing, range and detection limits for every channel.
OPEN PILLAR →
MTDI / PILLAR 00
Pillar 00 · Evidence

Validation Chamber

Before anything is interpreted, every channel proves it is present, fresh, on time and inside its declared range. Detection limits come from its own measured noise: LOD = 3σ, LOQ = 10σ.

01Baselines
Environmental Intelligence
Learn, lock and compare the real environment each channel sits in.
OPEN PILLAR →
MTDI / PILLAR 01
Pillar 01 · Baselines

Environmental Intelligence

Each channel learns its baseline from the real environment with a time-windowed median that refuses excursions. Lock it, save it under a name, compare against it later. Simulated data can never be saved as an environment.
